title: sabulina litorea
intro: Sabulina litorea, commonly known as sea spurge, is a succulent plant species found in coastal areas. It is rich in health benefits, including anti-inflammatory, antibacterial, and antioxidant properties, which can help to soothe skin irritations and protect against cell damage. The therapeutic actions of Sabulina litorea include wound healing, anti-aging, and immune system support, due to its bioactive constituents such as flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids. These constituents are believed to be responsible for the plant's medicinal properties, making it a valuable natural remedy for various health conditions.
